ReplyTo.description:
Where a target sends the reply to a request of a flow: the run that waits and the id of the request's message. The
schema of every [`ReplyTo`], whatever its reply type.

request.description: The id of the request's message.

run.description: The run that waits for the reply.

Start.description: Starts the job; its result goes to `reply`.
Start.title: Start

state.description:
The state of an actor type that keeps no data: an empty struct, stored as `{}`. A state with a field does not
decode as `NoState`.
state.title: NoState
